hofrim.card.carbide.d: +2 dig power — hard rock breaks in a third of the time
hofrim.card.sweep.d: Digs three cells wide — a tunnel, not a hole
hofrim.card.blastdig.d: Every cell you break explodes and hits whatever's around it
hofrim.card.vest.d: A chance to take a hit with no damage
hofrim.card.reload.d: −35% reload time — the fire becomes a stream
hofrim.card.salvo.d: Shoots in two directions at once
hofrim.card.pierce.d: The bullet passes through monsters instead of stopping
hofrim.card.homing.d: The bullet curves toward the nearest monster
hofrim.card.burn.d: A monster that's hit keeps burning
hofrim.card.frost.d: A hit freezes the monster to half speed
hofrim.card.heavy.d: Ignores armor — the armored one and the golem stop being immune
hofrim.card.chain.d: The hit jumps to more monsters
hofrim.card.boomshot.d: Every hit explodes and hits everything around
hofrim.card.charge.d: Bomb button: opens up a whole room in a second
hofrim.card.heavycharge.d: Bigger blast radius and a shorter cooldown
hofrim.card.alchemy.d: Rock broken by the blast turns to gold
hofrim.card.xray.d: See crystals and monsters through the ground
hofrim.card.glow.d: Every tunnel you dig stays lit — the whole team sees where you've been
hofrim.card.magnet.d: Loot flies to you from afar
hofrim.card.double.d: A quarter of the cells give loot twice
hofrim.card.share.d: 10% of every deposit you make also counts for the nearest friend
hofrim.you_fell: 💀 You went down — back up in a moment
